slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: You can play the ball off your own back glass.

slides.line:
Your own walls
are fair game.

steps.text: Hit into your own back glass

posts.caption:
Welcome to Fair or Fault – your daily padel quiz! 🎾

First question, easy one: can you smash the ball into your OWN back glass and let it fly over the net? Yes – as long as it then bounces on the other side.

Comment FAIR or FAULT before you swipe 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: Your serve hits the fence after the bounce.

slides.line:
Glass is fine.
The fence is not.

posts.caption:
Bounces in. Clips the fence. Your partner is already celebrating… should they be? 🎾

After the bounce, a serve may touch the glass – but the wire fence ends it. Second serve.

Comment FAIR or FAULT before you swipe 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: You must serve at waist height or lower.

slides.line:
No tennis serves.
Waist height, max.

posts.caption:
Former tennis players, this one's for you 👀

In padel you hit the serve with the ball at or below your waist. No big overhead serve.

FAIR or FAULT? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

posts.fact_source: Carbon tow designation: K = thousands of filaments per tow

slides.label: Gear
slides.claim: on a racket means 12 kg of carbon.

posts.caption:
3K, 12K, 18K… sounds like a weight class, right? 🏋️

The K counts filaments: 12K = 12,000 carbon fibres in each thread of the weave.

Knew it? Drop a ✅
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

posts.fact_source: FIP Reglamento de Juego, Regla 8.1 and Caso 3

slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: You are allowed to volley the return of a serve.

slides.line:
The serve must
bounce in your
box first.

posts.caption:
Tempting to step in and volley that soft serve, right? 😏

No. The receiver must always let the serve bounce in the box first.

FAIR or FAULT? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

posts.fact_source: Padel Magazine and Padel Addict 2026: Coello first player to win 10 Majors

slides.label: Pros
slides.claim: Major titles: Arturo Coello got there first.

posts.caption:
Ten. Major. Titles. 🏆

Arturo Coello is the first player in padel history to win 10 Majors.

Who's your favourite pro? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: Your racket touches the net. You lose the point.

slides.line:
Net and posts
are off limits.

posts.caption:
That perfect volley at the net… and your racket touches the tape 😬

Point gone. If your body or racket touches the net or the posts during a rally, you lose the point.

FAIR or FAULT? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.label: Market
slides.claim: padel courts in the whole world.

posts.caption:
How many padel courts does the world have? Guess before you swipe 🌍

58,334 – six times more than in 2016. And still not enough at 7 pm on a Tuesday.
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: You must bounce the ball before you serve.

slides.line:
Drop it, let it
bounce, then hit.

posts.caption:
Padel serve basics 🎾

You always bounce the ball on the floor first – behind the service line – and then hit it.

FAIR or FAULT? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

posts.fact_source: FIP Reglamento, La Pala: solid perforated face
posts.caption:
Your non-padel friends call it a "bat" for a reason 🏓

No strings: a padel racket has a solid face with holes – foam inside, carbon or fibreglass outside.

Tag the friend who still calls it a tennis racket 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: Your shot hits their back glass before it bounces.

slides.line:
It must bounce
on their floor first.

posts.caption:
Full power, straight into their back glass, no bounce. Winner? 💥

No – the ball must bounce on their floor before it touches any of their walls.

FAIR or FAULT? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: You are allowed to let the ball bounce twice.

posts.caption:
Slow ball, you're a bit late… two bounces? 🐢

No. You must hit the ball before it bounces a second time on your side.

FAIR or FAULT? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

posts.fact_source: FIP Reglamento, La Pala: max 45.5 cm long, 26 cm wide, 38 mm thick

slides.label: Gear
slides.claim: is the maximum length of a padel racket.

posts.caption:
Head + handle together: 45.5 cm, not a millimetre more 📏

And the face can be max 26 cm wide and 38 mm thick.

Did you know the numbers? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.label: Rules
slides.claim: Serve touches the net, lands in: you serve again.

slides.line:
Net + in = replay.
Unless it then
hits the **fence**.

posts.caption:
Net cord on the serve, ball drops in the box. Fault? 🤔

No – you simply serve again. Only if it then hits the fence does it become a fault.

FAIR or FAULT? 👇
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

posts.fact_source: Global Padel Report 2026: Spain most courts; France most new courts in 2025

posts.caption:
Spain still has more padel courts than any other country 🇪🇸

But the fastest builder in 2025? France 🇫🇷

Which country is next? 👇
